explanation: This slide outlines the results of the mouse camouflage experiment (Case Study 2). The noncamouflaged mouse models suffered a much higher percentage of predatory attacks in both beach and inland habitats. These findings supported the key prediction of the camouflage hypothesis, showing that matching coloration acts as an adaptive defense against predation.
